Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the genealogical information in the final step. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Nakkhatra Mangala was the son of Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana, the Planner erroneously concluded that the paternal grandfather was "King Chulalongkorn (Rama V)." This is a factual error; King Chulalongkorn was the father of Prince Voralaksana, making him the great-grandfather of Busba Kitiyakara, not the paternal grandfather. The paternal grandfather is Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksana. The Planner failed to correctly map the three-generation lineage (Busba -> Nakkhatra Mangala -> Voralaksana -> Chulalongkorn) and jumped to the wrong generation.
